title: Barnyard Count
description: A counting game for little kids. A friendly voice asks for a number of farm animals, and kids slide that many chicks, piggies, cows, sheep, ducks or bunnies into the barn while every one is counted out loud and lit up on the fence.
controls: Press an animal and slide it into the barn door. Tap the question to hear it again.
requirements: Any modern browser. Saves stars in this browser.
